news.headline: Taiwan overtakes India as world's 5th largest stock market
news.summary: Taiwan's stock market has now surpassed India's in value. This shift is largely due to a strong performance by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. The island's market capitalization reached $4.95 trillion. India's market value stands at $4.92 trillion. This development highlights the significant impact of artificial intelligence on global markets and manufacturing hubs.
news.takeaway: Taiwan's stock market has now surpassed India's in value; Global Tech is semiconductor-cycle evidence; Indian IT needs Nasdaq breadth and USD/INR support to inherit it.
news.whyItMatters: Factory and capex data can move metals, capital goods and exporters differently, so the index read needs sector confirmation.

news.watchFor: Watch Nasdaq futures plus Nifty IT advance-decline; chip strength alone is not enough.

news.headline: LIC 1:1 bonus bonanza: Is today the last day to buy shares for free rewards?
news.summary: LIC has set May 29 as the record date for its maiden 1:1 bonus issue, making May 27 the last day for investors to buy shares for eligibility. This corporate action will see the insurer issue one free share for every share held, capitalizing reserves.
